question: For every finite planar point set P, does the sum over distinct determined distances of unordered-pair distance multiplicities equal P.card.choose 2?
proposed_result:
Yes, for the exact bounded occurrence Erdos94.erdos_94.variants.sum_multiplicity. Let O = {(p,q) ∈ P × P | p ≠ q} be the finite set of ordered off-diagonal pairs, let q(p,q) = s(p,q) be the associated Sym2 unordered pair, and let U = q '' O. Define δ(s(p,q)) = dist p q; this is well-defined because distance is symmetric. Let D = δ '' U be the finite set of determined distances, and U_d = {u ∈ U | δ(u)=d}. The fibers U_d for d ∈ D are disjoint and cover U, hence the finite fiber identity gives ∑ d ∈ D, |U_d| = |U|. Moreover U is exactly the set of two-element unordered selections from P, so Mathlib's Sym2.card_image_offDiag yields |U| = P.card.choose 2. Therefore ∑ d ∈ D, |U_d| = P.card.choose 2.

If the source definition expresses multiplicity as half an ordered-pair count, the required parity step is also exact: for each d, q maps O_d = {(p,q) ∈ O | dist p q=d} onto U_d. Every fiber over s(p,q) has exactly the two representatives (p,q) and (q,p); they are distinct because O excludes the diagonal, and there are no other representatives by equality in Sym2. Thus |O_d| = 2·|U_d|, so |O_d| / 2 = |U_d| by Nat.mul_div_left (or the corresponding normalized arithmetic lemma). This proves evenness before division and eliminates a truncating-division gap. Summing then counts each unordered pair once, at its unique distance.

Concrete Lean route: work classically; form P.offDiag and its image under Sym2.mk (using Sym2.mk.uncurry where available); define the symmetric distance function on Sym2 via Sym2.fromRel or quotient lifting; rewrite the set of determined distances as U.image δ; rewrite each multiplicity as (U.filter fun u => δ u = d).card, proving that rewrite from the ordered definition with a constant-two fiber-cardinality lemma; use Finset.sum_card_fiberwise (or a Finset.sum_bij over the disjoint fibers) to obtain ∑ d ∈ U.image δ, (U.filter fun u => δ u = d).card = U.card; finally discharge U.card = P.card.choose 2 with Sym2.card_image_offDiag. The pinned Formal Conjectures environment may require the mechanical API spelling change between Sym2.mk.uncurry and Sym2.mk recorded in the local claim caveats.

assumptions_and_dependencies: Distance symmetry, dist p q = dist q p, is used to descend distance from ordered pairs to Sym2.
The off-diagonal condition p ≠ q is essential: it makes the two swapped ordered representatives distinct and makes every quotient fiber have cardinality exactly two.
The Lean implementation depends on the pinned Mathlib finite-set and Sym2 APIs, especially Sym2.card_image_offDiag and an appropriate finite fiber-sum lemma.

The exact target's multiplicity must either already be the unordered fiber cardinality or be definitionally/propositionally reducible to half the ordered fiber cardinality via the constant-two quotient-fiber argument.
limitations: This Result covers only Erdos94.erdos_94.variants.sum_multiplicity; it does not prove or advance the main cubic Erdős 94 theorem or either other variant.
